title: Egyptian Chicken Toast
description: A simple and flavorful Egyptian-inspired dish made with chicken, toasted bread, and a hint of nutty spices.

ingredients.name: nutty spice blend
ingredients.notes: mix of coriander, cumin, and cardamom

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and nutty spice blend. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the egyptian flatbread until lightly browned.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Assemble the toast by spreading unsalted butter on each slice, then topping with sliced chicken and a sprinkle of nutty spice blend.
